newsitem.title: UK: Metropolitan Bank sets $219 mln exchangeable bond.
newsitem.headline: Metropolitan Bank sets $219 mln exchangeable bond.

text.p: MBI Finance Ltd has issued a $219 million zero-coupon bond exchangeable into shares of Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co, lead manager Flemings said.
The bond matures on December 18, 2001. Issue price is 68.44 percent and the exchange price is 670 pesos, a 10.5 percent premium over the 15-day average closing share price.
Forex rate is fixed at 26.296 pesos per dollar. Every bond ($10,000) equals 268.61 shares.

Final redemption at par yields around 175 basis points over five-year U.S. Treasury notes. There is a hard non call for three years, and thereafter the bonds are callable at par subject to a 140 percent trigger.
Payment date is expected on December 18. The exchange period runs from March 1, 1997 to December 4, 2001.
Sales restrictions apply in the UK, US, Philippines and Hong Kong.
